verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government IP office with online filing and search services, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers only procedural service descriptions and never mentions an API, OpenAPI document, or downloadable spec. The llms.txt probe returned 404, which also shows no agent-oriented documentation is published.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
